results.name: Golden Gate Bridge

Use a wide three-quarter viewpoint, cool ocean, distant hills and warm afternoon sun. Prioritize structural correctness over decoration.

No WebGL, Three.js, 3D engine, external assets, images, fonts, imports or network calls. Depict the requested perspective using 2D shapes, paths and gradients. Create polished lighting, shadows and material variation with gradients and layered shapes. Frame the complete monument with its top and base visible and at least 10% margin. Do not obstruct it with foreground objects. No text overlays. Deterministic artwork, 1200x800 composition. Prioritize the visual result and working code. Use no more than 32000 output tokens including reasoning.
